decisionTick: One global event-driven one-second tick, emitted only after at least one non-2CQ external decoded Pump causal event has been observed in that second.
candidateEligibility: Pump CREATE/CREATE_V2 observed in the same full-meta source within 120 seconds; at least one non-2CQ external causal state; valid finite frozen-V2 features.
teacherIsolation: The 2CQ wallet journal is never read by this lane.  2CQ causal events are not state updates and cannot trigger ticks, persistence, ranking, or FIRE state.
fireSemantics: UNSET_PRE_WHEN_DEVELOPMENT; no score threshold, cooldown, or trade decision is applied.
causalOrdering: Original source receipt time is primary; source observed slot/index is retained; finalized block proofs reconcile compact causal events before a tick becomes FINAL.
continuity: Any source reconnect, continuity gap, malformed frame, canonical-proof discrepancy, or uncertain rotation fails the lane closed.
memoryBound: Only current 120-second candidate event state and bounded SQLite-backed compact records are retained in memory; source partitions are tailed incrementally.
retention: Compact decision/event/proof records are append-only. Existing raw lane remains authoritative and its existing protections are unchanged.

stoppingRules.development: At least 72 uninterrupted valid wall-clock hours AND 350 independent canonical teacher acquisitions after immutable boundary.
stoppingRules.validation: Immediately following development: at least 72 uninterrupted valid wall-clock hours AND 150 independent canonical teacher acquisitions, untouched.
